executableContent.instructions: Complete `filter_courses()` so it sends a `GET` request to the supplied URL with the `filters` dictionary as request parameters and returns the `\"results\"` list from the parsed JSON response.

files.name: script.py
files.solvedContent:
import requests

def filter_courses():
  url = "https://things.mimo.dev/api/things"
  filters = {"category": "electronics"}
  response = requests.get(url, params=filters)
  data = response.json()
  return data["results"]

files.solvedContent:
import requests

def find_character(name):
  url = "https://swapi.mimo.dev/api/people"
  filters = {"search": name}
  response = requests.get(url, params=filters)
  response.raise_for_status()
  data = response.json()
  return data["results"][0]["name"]

import requests

def load_pokemon(pokemon_id):
  url = f"https://pokedex.mimo.dev/api/pokemon/{pokemon_id}"
  response = requests.get(url)
  response.raise_for_status()
  data = response.json()
  return data["name"]

import requests

def load_pokemon(name):
  url = f"https://pokedex.mimo.dev/api/pokemon/{name}"
